content: Jesu, Pilate Nanamaim Bat Ibabatiy
Maraumanaika, firis ukwarih naatu regaregah ai’in, Ofafar bai’obaiyenayah naatu kaniser etei hiru’ay hiyakitifuw. Imaibo Jesu uman hifatum hibonawiy hin Pilate biyan hitubar.
Pilate Jesu ibatiy eo, “O Jew hai aiwob?” Jesu iya’afut eo, “Bo nati ku’o.”
Naatu firis ukwarih Jesu isan baifufuwen maumurih maiyow hibow hitit bowabow kakafin sinaf hirouw hio.
Imih Pilate Jesu ibatiy maiye? “O boro tur ta inao? O baifufuwenayan hiruw te’o kunonowar!”
Baise Jesu men kok boro tur tao maiye, imih Pilate ana kasiy ra’at men kafaita.
Jesu Morob Isan Hirubin
Gawan hai sinaf mar etei Tatar Nowaten hiyuw ana veya sabuw hai kokomaim teo orot menatan dibur ema’am Pilate ebobotait.
Nati ana veya orot wabin Barabas i diburamaim ma’am, iti orot i sabuw hai kou’ay ta hibai uruw hirufufur hinan wanawanan orot ta easabun morob.
Imih sabuw hai kou’ay hibai naatu hai kok orot menatan mar etei esisinaf na’atube tabotait isan Pilate hifefeyan.
Naatu Pilate ibatiyih, “Kwakokok ayu Jew hai aiwob isa anabotait?”
Anayabin Pilate i so’ob firis ukwarih Jesu isan hibibobowen, imih hibai hina umanamaim hiyai.
Baise firis ukwarih sabuw tafah fair hiyai hi’o totofarih Jesu efanin Barabas botaitin isan Pilate hifefeyan.
Pilate iban maiye sabuw ibatiyih, “Abistan kwakokok ayu iti orot Jew hai aiwob kwarouw kwao isan ana sinaf?”
Sabuw hiwow hio, “Ku’onaf!”
Pilate ibatiyih maiye, “‘‘Bo abistan kakafin sinaf?” Baise sabuw fanah aumetawat hiwow hio, “Ku’onaf!”
Pilate kok kwanekwan mi’itube rou’ay tiyasisirih, imih sabuw isah Barabas diburane botait tit. Naatu Jesu bai misamaim biyan rab tut veyaveyar, imaibo baiyowayah uwih onafin isan hibai hitit.
Baiyowayah Jesu Hi’i’iyab
Baiyowayah Jesu hibai gawan ana bar merar imaim hirun, gawan hai bowabow efan gagamin naatu hai ofonah etei’imak hi’af ayuwih.
Faifuw namar hibai Jesu hi’osenawain, kokor nukwarin ana kowasamih hififin.
Naatu hibusuruf hi’i’iyab ana merar hiyi hio, “Aki erekakaf abobora’ara’ahi Jew hai aiwob!”
Wabukamaim nukwarin hitut, hikwaitututur, suh hiyowen hikwafir moyamoy.
Hibi’i’iyab ufunamaim, faifuw namar hibosair naatu Jesu ana faifuw hi’us maiye, naatu hibonawiy hitit onafin isan hin.
Jesu Hi’onaf
Hitit hinan efamaim orot wabin Simon Sairini mowan, masaw barene au Jerusalem bar merar nan bairi hitar, Alexander naatu Rufus hairi tamah. Baiyowayah hi’ukikin Jesu ana onaf abarin isan.
Jesu hibai hin efan wabin Golgotha hitit, efan ana’itin i ukwarih ana rarikabe.
Nati’imaim wine naatu harew fokarin ta wabin myrrh auman hisartabir Jesu tomamih hibitin, baise men tom.
Baiyowayah Jesu hi’onaf, ana faifuw hifaram hibow hima hi’arow saise arowamaim ti’obaiyih, Jesu ana faifuw menatan boro tab.
Mar auman veya nine korok na’atube Jesu hi’onaf.
Jesu sinaf kakaf hirouw hio ubar hibitin ana tur ukwarinamaim hikirum hio, “Jew Hai Aiwob.” Tafanamaim hikubar.
Naatu orot kakafih rou’ab auman hi’onafih, ta ana beyawane ta ana asukwafune.
Iti na’atube mamatar i Bukamaim hikikirum na iturobe, i boro bainowah bairi hina’onafih.
Sabuw na hinan, ne hinan Jesu hi’i’itin hi’i’iyab nah hita’asi’asiy hio, “Ige aro! O Tafaror Bar tarabounin veya taunu wanawanan wowabin yen irouw i’o’oban iti ku’inu’in?”
Taiyuw kwiyawasi onaf afe’enane kura’iyeban a’itin.
Sinaf ta’imon firis ukwarih naatu Ofafar bai’obaiyenayah Jesu hi’i’iyab, taiyuwih hio, “Afa ibiyawasih, baise i taiyuwin boro men niyawas.
Kwabat Rubininenayan ta’itin, Israel sabuw hai aiwob boun onaf afe’enane nare tana’itin, saife tanitumitum.” Naatu orot rou’ab Jesu bairi hi’o’onafih auman tur ta’imon hi’o higigim.
Jesu Momorob
Veya yen in tafat yan, basit tafaram tutufin etei gugum in veya three korok bai.
Veya three korok baib Jesu fanan aumetawat itarakouw rerey eo, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabaktani” anayabin “Au God Au God, aisimamih ihamiyu?”
Sabuw afa nati’imaim hibatabat hinowar hio, “Kwanowar Elijah isan eafa’af.”
Orot ta nunuw in harew sususub tainen bai wine tenakuyakuy butu’ub naatu isik yomaninamaim iyouw, eot ra’ah Jesu susubinamih, baise orot ta eo, “Kwabat! Elijah nan onafane nab nayayare tana’itin!”
Jesu ibanak maiye fanan aumetawat na’in itarakouw rerey, basit ayubin tabaratait naatu morob.
Tafaror Bar wanawanan efan kakafiyin awan faifuw hitenafut in rorore tafantoro’ot taseb re uran tit rou’ab himatar.
Baiyowayan orot ukwarin nati onaf nanamaim batabat, Jesu mi’itube momorob itin naatu eo, “Turobe iti orot i anababatun God Natun!”
Nati’imaim i baibin afa auman, ef yokaika hibat hinuwanuw. Baibin wanawanahimaim i Mary Magdalin, Mary kek James boubun naatu Joseph hairi hinah naatu Salome.
Iti baibin i Galilee’imaim Jesu hi’ufunun baibais hitin bairi hibowabow i hina. Naatu baibin maumurih maiyow bairi hina Jerusalem hititit i auman nati’imaim hibatabat.
Jesu Rahemaim Hiyai
Veya re irabirab, naatu nati rabirab i yabunabuna ana veya, anayabin mar natoto i Baiyarir ana veya.
Imih Joseph Arimathea’ane na tit. Iti orot i kaniser ana kou’ay orot ta. God ana aiwob isan ma kakakaf. Joseph Jesu biyan bain isan itafofor na Pilate nanamaim tit ifefeyan.
Naatu Pilate Jesu momorob ana tur men so’ob, imih baiyowayah ukwarin isan e’af na ibatiy.
Baiyowayah ukwarin eo nonowar ufunamaim Pilate ibasit Joseph Jesu biyan bain isan.
Naatu bairahiya ana faifuw bai na Jesu bu’ub yare sum, bai in to naiwanamaim tar inu’in imaim yai, kabay gagamin ifururuw na hub awan hir.
Mary Magdalin naatu Mary Joseph hinah hairi Jesu biyan menamaim hiya’iy i hi’itin.
